articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 114 (pearl-level metal), roughness 96 (satin gloss), clearcoat 76 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: numbers without outline, next to other busy finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: none to very little: it is already busy with two scales of detail; large soft fades: a wide gradient can sit under it without adding clutter
Patterns to avoid: fine line or hatch patterns: they fight the engraved lines; other dot or flake patterns: they muddy the gold motifs
Spec overlays that work: gentle gloss/matte zoning: leaves the gold blobs readable; broad clearcoat variation: adds depth without more grain
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

examples.title: Put it on a zone
examples.goal: See We The People on the car.
examples.result: The finish shows its own colours and spec together.
